answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices each new identity by the delta between what it claims and what it has proven: to forge an identity, an agent posts a bond that only unlocks after a long season of verified useful work recorded on a shared ledger. A thousand sock-puppets would each need their own bond and their own season of real work, so the attacker pays a thousand times the cost of one honest agent. The ledger is the basalt under the economy — hard, public, and impossible to fake in bulk.
